changelog:
- Initial public release.
- Provides model deployment and testing for LLM, VL, Embedding, and Rerank models on Huawei Cloud Ascend DevServer (910B series).
- Supports both single-machine and dual-machine deployment modes.
- Enables inference testing, deployment log viewing, and deployment status monitoring.
- Features automated model matching and deployment script generation.
- Minor update: removed skill-card.md file.
summary: Huawei Cloud Ascend model deployment and testing skill for large language models on Ascend DevServer (910B series). Supports single-machine and dual-machine deployment for LLM, VL (vision-language), Embedding, and Rerank models. Provides model inference testing, deployment log viewing, and status monitoring with automated model matching and deployment script generation. Use this skill when the user wants to: (1) deploy a model on Ascend DevServer, (2) test model inference, (3) view deployment logs or status, (4) list supported models, (5) check deployment prerequisites. Trigger: deploy, test, model list, deployment log, Ascend, DevServer, 910B, ModelArts, LLM, VL, Embedding, Rerank, multimodal, inference, model catalog, 昇腾, 部署模型, 测试模型, 模型列表, 部署日志, 模型部署, 推理测试
